episodes.title: Fate
episodes.summary: Tae Oh, In Ha, and Hye Won run towards the same desire. They are drawn to one another by fate.

episodes.title: Beginning
episodes.summary: In pursuit of desires, Tae Oh, In Ha, and Hye Won become entangled in a triangle.

episodes.title: Desirers
episodes.summary: Tae Oh ousts Sung Joo from the Co-prosperity Cooperation Center and Chairman Kang collapses.

episodes.title: Thrill
episodes.summary: Tae Oh begins a dangerous game to make In Ha's presence known to the world.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.summary: The difference between Taeoh and Inha is revealed, and a fatal blow is aimed at Taeoh.

episodes.title: Weakness
episodes.summary: Taeoh chases the culprit who tried to kill him and faces impending doom.

episodes.title: Reality
episodes.summary: Taeoh is arrested as a murder suspect. Dark shadows lurk around him with his memories missing.

episodes.title: Scream
episodes.summary: Taeoh continues his search for the truth and must formulate a new plan after he faces it.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.summary: Taeoh's lost memories come back one by one and he can confirm the face of his culprit with them.

episodes.title: Trigger
episodes.summary: The murder culprit is revealed, but he is just a bait thrown by Taeoh to catch the real villain.

episodes.title: Malice
episodes.summary: Taeoh awaits for "that moment." Will he protect his people and achieve his dreams?

episodes.title: Choice
episodes.summary: In fulfilling his desires, Taeoh does not choose anger or forgiveness. His choice is salvation.
